description: This Java class defines a scheduled task for processing HL7 messages in the queue within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It initializes a static HL7 processor and executes its processing method in the execute() function, handling exceptions related to HL7 processing.

classes.name: ProcessHL7InQueueTask
classes.description: A scheduled task class responsible for processing incoming HL7 messages from the queue in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: ProcessHL7InQueueTask
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the static HL7InQueueProcessor instance, creating it if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task to process HL7 messages from the queue, handling session management and exceptions.
